summary:
Iteration 4 testing complete. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py — 16/16 PASS — covering Alembic head 7497425df8bc + 4 new org cert_* columns; outbox pagination shape + page-2 disjoint + out-of-range; outbox filters (status/q/template); outbox stats endpoint; course duplicate (admin 200, learner 403, missing 404, DRAFT + slides_copied verified + cleaned); prerequisite CRUD (POST/GET/DELETE); org PATCH cert_accent_color/cert_signature_text/cert_footer_text + GET round-trip; PDF cert renders %PDF even with malformed accent_color 'not-a-colour' (graceful fallback verified); outbox worker actually drains QUEUED → STUB within ~12s + /complete decoupled (returned <8s). Regression: 68/69 (test_take_exam_and_grading fails with 'Maximum attempts reached' — pre-existing seed-data pollution from prior runs, unrelated to iteration 4). Also fixed 3 brittle iteration3 tests that hardcoded old outbox list shape (now returns {messages, page, page_size, total, total_pages}) and old alembic head — these were incompatible with the iteration-4 API change but the new contract is correct.

Frontend Playwright: admin login → Settings link visible in sidebar; /outbox shows stats cards (60 Stub, 0 Sent/Queued/Failed), search input, status filter dropdown, Prev/Next + pager — all data-testids resolved; clicking Next worked; /settings full form rendered with Identity (name/desc/logo), Brand colours (primary #6366f1 + cert accent #10b981 with colour pickers), Certificate template (signature text, signature image URL, footer text), Save button present; /courses shows 10 cards each with duplicate-{id} button — click on duplicate-1 created new DRAFT 'IFPI Fundamentals (copy)' card; /courses/1/edit shows prereqs-section + add-prereq-btn → modal lists 10 pickable courses with pick-prereq-{id} testids.

minor.issue: API shape changed from List[Message] to {messages, page, page_size, total, total_pages} — breaking change for any external consumers; iteration3 tests had to be updated. Frontend is already migrated. Internal-only API so impact is contained.

action_items: (Optional) Reset learner exam attempts counter or up the test-mode max-attempts cap — test_take_exam_and_grading fails after enough regression runs (NOT an iteration-4 bug, but it now permanently fails in this env until the counter is reset).
(Optional) Document the GET /api/admin/outbox shape change in API changelog — iteration 3 consumers expected a flat list; iteration 4 returns a paginated envelope.
critical_code_review_comments: APScheduler worker confirmed running: a fresh /complete enqueues QUEUED, then within ~5-10s the tick stamps it STUB. Decoupling works — /complete returned in <8s end-to-end including PDF gen + outbox insert. No latency from upstream mail.

Course duplicate correctly creates DRAFT (verified status=DRAFT on the new row) and copies all 5 slides. Title gets ' (copy)' suffix. Learner POST returns 403; non-existent course returns 404. Good auth + 404 hygiene.

Cert PDF renderer is robust: malformed accent_color 'not-a-colour' falls back to default indigo without raising — verified the response is still a valid %PDF document with new branding overrides applied.
Outbox pagination clamps page_size correctly (verified page_size=5 returns at most 5 rows; page=999 returns empty messages but valid pagination meta with total still populated).

Settings page UX is clean — colour swatch + hex input pair for both primary and cert accent, with explicit 'Defaults to Primary if empty' helper text on the accent field. Save changes button persists across reloads.
Frontend Outbox page rewrite is solid: stats counters auto-update via /api/admin/outbox/stats; search box debounces; status filter + pager all wired up via the new paginated endpoint.
Prerequisite modal correctly excludes self (course 1 not shown when editing course 1) and shows status badges (PUBLISHED/DRAFT) per row.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (fixed 3 outdated assertions: alembic head + outbox API shape change — was list, now dict)

success_rate.backend: 98.5% (68/69 — 16 it4 PASS + 14/15 it3 PASS post-fix + 11/11 it2 + 27/27 it1; 1 unrelated exam-attempts failure)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-4 critical flows verified (sidebar Settings link, /settings form, /outbox pagination+filters+stats, /courses duplicate buttons, /courses/:id/edit prereqs modal)

seed_data_creation: Cleaned up 2 leftover 'IFPI Fundamentals (copy)' DRAFT courses created during UI testing. test_iteration4 fixtures self-clean (TEST_it4_prereq_* deleted after test). Some TEST_prereq_* courses remain from prior iterations — harmless seed pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alembic head is now 7497425df8bc (org_cert_branding). Full regression: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v runs 69 tests (~40s). The known-failing test_take_exam_and_grading needs the learner's exam_attempts counter reset to pass; it's not related to iteration 4 features. New testids referenced: outbox-search, outbox-status-filter, outbox-pager, outbox-prev, outbox-next, duplicate-{id}, prereqs-section, add-prereq-btn, add-prereq-modal, pick-prereq-{id}, org-settings-page, org-save-btn, org-logo-url, org-sig-text, org-footer-text. To force outbox worker tick during tests: `from services.outbox_worker import _tick; _tick()`.
